description: This file defines the 'NodeTraverser' class within the Twig templating engine. It manages visiting all nodes in a syntax tree, applying registered visitors to each node during traversal.

classes.name: NodeTraverser
classes.description: A class responsible for traversing nodes in the Twig syntax tree and applying a set of visitor objects to each node.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the NodeTraverser with an Environment and optional array of visitors, adding each visitor to the internal list.

methods.name: addVisitor
methods.description: Adds a node visitor to the traverser's list of visitors based on its priority.

methods.name: traverse
methods.description: Traverses a Node object, applying all registered visitors in order of priority.

methods.name: traverseForVisitor
methods.description: Internal method that applies a single visitor to a node and its children recursively.
